cases.name: Lisa Darlene Smith
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Lisa lived in Frankfort for the last 6 years and had resided in Colorado, Mississippi, and Illinois.  She attended Frankfort Schools and worked as a CNA before becoming a caregiver with Abilities Service, Inc.  She loved being outdoors and enjoyed fishing, camping, music, daytime TV, playing Yatzee with her daughter Tia, playing Texas Hold ‘Em with her son Cody, and simply talking with her son Kyle."

cases.about: Her obituary said, "Pamela worked at NHK in Frankfort. Pamela was a hard worker who loved her family and especially her grandchildren. She enjoyed feeding the squirrels and birds, cooking and will be remembered for her 4th of July parties."
